02 / THE PERSONA LITTLE CONTEXT

CURIOSITY
IN. CREATION
OUT.

The best part of an idea?
Making it real.

Hi, I’m Sarayu — a software engineer who likes connecting the dots between AI, useful products, and the people using them.

I’m a Computer Science graduate from Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bengaluru. My work spans full-stack development, machine learning, and the engineering that brings them together.

At HashedIn by Deloitte, I worked on Compass: a desktop app that brings product-management workflows and AI assistants into one place. Outside that, I build things like simulated audiences, adaptive exercise systems, and tools that help developers work.
